decisions.reason: The program directly extends the firm's psychiatric care knowledge, allowing it to interpret feedback and improve the service effectively.
Outpatient sociotherapy is closely related to existing mental health and social work, so the firm can assimilate results and refine the offer with confidence.
Senior living counseling leverages established eldercare knowledge, enabling the firm to evaluate outcomes and adapt quickly, making withdrawal unlikely.
Retail operations are less familiar than core care services, weakening the firm's absorptive capacity in this area, though sheltered workshop ties keep the drop probability moderate.
Meal delivery aligns with the firm's everyday-life assistance for seniors, but the food logistics are less central to its care expertise, so there is some uncertainty about learning from results.
